content.short: MPCVault is a non-custodial wallet that supports multi-chain, multi-asset, and multi-sig.
content.description: MPCVault is a non-custodial wallet designed for Web3 teams and businesses that need secure, flexible control over digital assets. It is multi-chain, supports multisignature governance, and handles multiple asset types, enabling coordinated activity across diverse networks and ecosystems. Each day, MPCVault secures millions of transfers, earning the trust of more than 100 global businesses, including leading Web3 projects, trading firms, and venture capital firms worldwide.
